assets.name: retryWithTimeout
assets.summary: Runs an async task with a time limit on each attempt, and retries attempts that fail or hang.
assets.useWhen: calling a flaky dependency such as an HTTP API, a queue or a database, where one hung call must not hold the caller and a fresh attempt often succeeds. The task is called again for each attempt, so pass a function, not a promise.
signatures: export async function retryWithTimeout<T>( task: () => Promise<T>, options: RetryWithTimeoutOptions, ): Promise<Result<T, RetryError>>

assets.name: totalsBy
assets.summary: Groups items by a key, adds up a number per group, and lists the groups largest first.
assets.useWhen: building a report row per category, such as hours per team, revenue per product or errors per endpoint, where the biggest group should come first.
signatures: export function totalsBy<T>( items: readonly T[], key: (item: T) => string, value: (item: T) => number, ): readonly GroupTotal[]
export function totalsBy<T>( key: (item: T) => string, value: (item: T) => number, ): (items: readonly T[]) => readonly GroupTotal[]

assets.name: parsePort
assets.summary: Parses a TCP or UDP port number from a string, such as an environment variable.
assets.useWhen: reading `PORT` or the port part of `host:port` from config, where a value outside 1–65535 must stop startup instead of failing later inside `listen`.
signatures: export function parsePort(input: string): Result<number, ParsePortError>

assets.name: uniqueSlug
assets.summary: Turns a title into a URL slug that doesn't collide with the slugs already taken.
assets.useWhen: a new post, page or record needs a readable URL and some slugs are in use. The plain slug comes back when it is free, otherwise the first free `-2`, `-3`, … suffix.
signatures: export function uniqueSlug(title: string, taken: readonly string[]): string
export function uniqueSlug(taken: readonly string[]): (title: string) => string
